query:
SELECT a.id, a.name
                 FROM authors a
                WHERE EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM work_authors wa
                          JOIN manifestations m ON m.work_id = wa.work_id
                         WHERE wa.author_id = a.id AND wa.role = 'author'
                      )
                  AND immutable_unaccent(a.name) ILIKE immutable_unaccent_like($1) || '%'
                ORDER BY a.name ASC
                LIMIT $2
